import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Drop exact duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix species label variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix island label variant (strip spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix sex label variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'FEMALE': 'female'})
    
    # Convert text_number columns to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # For out_of_range body_mass_g, set values > 6500 or < 2500 to NaN
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    result = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return result
